custody_model: Custodial platform-hosted staking. First-party launch and current staking materials state that staked cryptoassets remain the property of eToro users while eToro executes the staking procedure on their behalf. CYA preserves that product statement without treating it as proof of legal segregation or insolvency protection across every eToro entity and jurisdiction.
yield_source: Proof-of-stake network rewards generated by supported cryptoassets, with eToro distributing a jurisdiction- and account-dependent share of staking yield after applicable operating and program deductions.
risk_notes: Risks include protocol and validator performance, slashing, liquidity and unstaking constraints, market volatility, platform/custody exposure, jurisdiction-specific eligibility and regulatory change. Express user-property language is not a guarantee of principal or insolvency outcome.

custody_model: Custodial Robinhood Crypto staking. The 2024 Europe launch states that European customers own their crypto while Robinhood holds it on their behalf. Current service spans different legal entities and jurisdictions and U.S. materials describe use of third-party staking partners, so CYA does not infer one universal legal-title, segregation or insolvency treatment across all customers.
yield_source: Underlying proof-of-stake protocol rewards, net of third-party staking partner fees and Robinhood Crypto fees where applicable. Rewards are variable and are not guaranteed by Robinhood Crypto.
risk_notes: Risks include protocol and validator performance, slashing, bonding and unbonding delays, reward-rate variability, third-party staking partner exposure, platform/custody exposure, fees and jurisdiction-specific regulatory or legal treatment.
